title: Bounded Local Observables in Factorizing Quantum Field Theories
exact_target: Determine when a wedge-local theory built from a factorizing scattering matrix contains observables in bounded spacetime regions.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30000341 (OWR-1109-001). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Noncommutative Geometry and Quantum Field Theory (2005), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2005/48, pp. 2705--2760; official report source and mathematical context.
Official EMS Press PDF of the same Oberwolfach report; PDF pages 11--12, printed pages 2715--2716.
Lechner factorizing S-matrix construction; reference in the saved dated catalogue literature review.

status_qualification: The target is the report's admissible factorizing S-matrix family and wedge construction. Its modular-nuclearity subfamily already has nontrivial double-cone observables; those positive cases do not settle every admissible S-matrix.
